_comment: World-mode entries. 'labels' are the classifier labels that map to each entry (ImageNet names work with a stock MobileNet). Add your own!

entries.name: Dog
entries.description: Forms deep bonds with its trainer. Its tail-wagging speed rises sharply whenever the word walk is spoken nearby.

entries.name: Cat
entries.description: Spends most of the day asleep in sunbeams. Knocks objects off tables to test the trainer's reflexes.

entries.name: Squirrel
entries.description: Buries thousands of nuts each autumn and forgets most of them, accidentally planting entire forests.

entries.name: Songbird
entries.description: Sings at sunrise to claim its territory. Some can tell trainers apart by the sound of their footsteps.

entries.name: Banana
entries.description: Ripens faster when stored next to its friends. Its peel is a legendary trap in kart racing.

entries.name: Coffee Mug
entries.description: Restores the trainer's energy each morning. Usually found half full and cold on a desk.

entries.name: Laptop
entries.description: Holds the code that makes this Pokédex work. Gets very warm when asked to train a neural network.

entries.name: Smartphone
entries.description: Its battery drains fastest exactly when the trainer needs it most.

entries.name: Pizza
entries.description: Appears at the end of every long build session. Restores full HP to the whole team.
